codebase_patterns.file_structure: src/ (cli.py, core.py, utils.py) + tests/ (test_cli.py, test_core.py, test_security.py)

common_mistakes: Always validate file paths before open() - use validate_file_path() from utils.py
Always check file size before reading with check_file_size() from utils.py
Use positive_int() validator for numeric argparse arguments
Add return type hints (-> None) to all functions
security_patterns: Path traversal protection via validate_file_path() in utils.py
File size limit (MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10MB) enforced before reads
Input validation on all user-controlled parameters
testing_patterns: Tests use capsys for output capturing
tempfile used for file I/O tests with proper cleanup
Security tests in separate test_security.py file
50 tests total, all must pass before commits

learnings: Path traversal vulnerability caught in code review - always validate file paths
Unbounded file reads can cause DoS - always check file size
argparse custom type validators work well for input bounds checking
